title: Stevenot Winery Halloween Party – CLICK HERE
description:
Join us for a Halloween Party at Stevenot Winery!

Enjoy an evening of wine, small bites, and music by DJ Lorraine. Come dressed in your best costume for a chance to win our 1st Place Costume Prize Basket!

Friday, October 30th
7–10 PM | $25 per ticket
Click HERE to purchase your tickets!

***Tickets are required in advance – no tickets sold at the door.

Costumes encouraged. Good times guaranteed.

Grab your friends and join us for a hauntingly fun night at Stevenot Winery!
